questions.q: What is Data Prep in CRM Analytics?
options: A JSON file editor for Apex
The visual interface where you build recipes to clean, join, and transform data into a dataset
A report type for Opportunities
A Chatter feature
questions.explain: Data Prep is the visual interface for building recipes as a graph of inputs, joins, transformations, and outputs.

questions.q: What is the main practical advantage of recipes over hand-editing a dataflow JSON file?
options: Recipes never need scheduling
Recipes are written in SOQL
Recipes only work with CSV files
You see a live preview of the data after each step
questions.explain: The preview table lets you validate joins and formulas immediately, without running the whole job.

questions.q: Which node type combines two sources on matching key fields?
options: Join
Output
Input
Schedule
questions.explain: A join node combines two sources on matching keys. Inputs bring data in, transforms modify it, and the output writes the dataset.

questions.q: Why should every recipe feeding a live dashboard be scheduled?
options: Otherwise the dashboard will not render at all
Salesforce charges extra for unscheduled recipes
Without a schedule the dataset goes stale, and dashboards are only as current as the last successful run
Scheduling changes the chart colors
questions.explain: Dashboards query the dataset, not live objects, so freshness depends on the recipe's last successful run.

questions.q: Your recipe preview shows many more rows than expected after joining Opportunities to another source. What is a likely cause?
options: The join key matches multiple rows on the other side, so rows are duplicated
Recipes double all numbers by default
The preview is always ten times larger
Data Sync is disabled
questions.explain: A one-to-many or non-unique join key multiplies rows. Inspect the join keys and the source's granularity in the graph.
